tips.label: 疑問詞 + 不定詞
tips.text: 用 wh- + to + 原形動詞表示該做什麼、該去哪裡或如何做：what to do、where to go、how to get there。

tips.label: 有些與其他一些
tips.text: Some ... Others ... Still others ...；後面要接複數名詞時，改用 some、other、still other。

tips.label: 三個中的最後一個
tips.text: 明確只有三個時：One ... Another ... The other ...。

notes.title: 名詞子句簡化為名詞片語
notes.rule: wh- + S + can / could / should + V → wh- + to V
notes.description: 當子句表示該做什麼或如何做，且省略的動作者可由主要子句的主詞或受詞清楚判斷時，常可改為疑問詞 + 不定詞。不能把所有 wh- 子句一律簡化。例如 I know where he lives. 陳述他住在哪裡，不能直接改成 I know where to live.。本課以 what、where、when、who、which、how 為主，不套用 why to V。
examples: Tom is thinking about where he should go on the weekend. → Tom is thinking about where to go on the weekend.（Tom 在想週末該去哪裡。）
Jeff will tell you what you can do when you are ready. → Jeff will tell you what to do when you are ready.（Jeff 會告訴你準備好時該做什麼；做事的人是 you。）
The tourist was wondering how she could get to the zoo. → The tourist was wondering how to get to the zoo.（那位遊客想知道如何到動物園。）

notes.title: to 後用原形動詞
notes.rule: 疑問詞（+ 名詞）+ to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 不定詞的 to 後面用原形動詞，不加 -s、-ed 或 -ing。which book、what time 等疑問詞與名詞可一起放在 to 前。who to ask 中 who 是 ask 的受詞。這類名詞片語可當主詞或受詞。
examples: Fiona has no idea who to ask for help.（Fiona 不知道該向誰求助。）
I cannot decide which book to buy.（我無法決定該買哪本書。）
What to do next is the question.（接下來該做什麼就是問題所在。）

notes.title: 多組中的兩組或三組
notes.description: 表示有些、其他一些、還有一些。others 是複數代名詞，後面不再加名詞，作主詞時搭配複數動詞。這個句型不必涵蓋全部；the others 才表示已知群體中剩下的全部。
examples: Some like basketball. Others like soccer. Still others like table tennis.（有些人喜歡籃球，其他一些人喜歡足球，還有一些人喜歡桌球。）

notes.title: 後接名詞的改寫
notes.rule: Some + 複數名詞 ... Other + 複數名詞 ... Still other + 複數名詞 ...
notes.description: others 若改成 other + 複數名詞，other 不加 s。可全用名詞形式，也可依語境混用代名詞形式。
examples: Some students like basketball. Other students like soccer. Still other students like table tennis.（有些學生喜歡籃球，其他一些學生喜歡足球，還有一些學生喜歡桌球。）
Some students like basketball. Others like soccer. Still others like table tennis.（意思相同，後兩組省略 students。）

notes.title: 限定三個的表達
notes.description: 只有三個對象時，先說一個，再說另一個，最後剩下的唯一一個用 the other。後面若接名詞，要用單數名詞；單独作主詞也視為單數。
examples: I have three pens. One is black, another is red, and the other is blue.（我有三支筆，一支黑色、一支紅色，最後一支藍色。）
One pen is black. Another pen is red. The other pen is blue.（用單數名詞 pen 說明三支筆。）

quiz.question: Tom is thinking about where ___ on the weekend.
quiz.hint: where 後接 to + 原形動詞，表示該去哪裡。

quiz.question: Jeff will tell you what ___ when you are ready.
quiz.hint: what to do 表示該做什麼，to 後用原形 do。

quiz.question: The tourist is wondering how ___ to the zoo.
quiz.hint: how to get 表示如何到達，使用疑問詞 + to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: Fiona has no idea who ___ for help.
quiz.hint: who to ask 表示該向誰詢問；who 是 ask 的受詞。

quiz.question: The host knows what ___ to make us laugh.
quiz.hint: what to say 表示該說什麼；to 後接原形 say。

quiz.question: I cannot decide which book ___ for my sister.
quiz.hint: which book 可整組放在不定詞前，which book to buy 表示該買哪本書。

quiz.question: Please show me how ___ this game.
quiz.hint: show me how to play 表示教我如何玩，to 後用原形。

quiz.question: We need to decide when ___ for school.
quiz.hint: when to leave 表示何時該出發，是疑問詞 + 不定詞。

quiz.question: Amy does not know where ___ her bike.
quiz.hint: where to park 表示該停在哪裡，park 用原形。

quiz.question: Can you tell me how ___ this box?
quiz.hint: how to open 是如何打開；不能在 to 後接 opening。

quiz.question: I am not sure what ___ to the party.
quiz.hint: what to wear 表示該穿什麼，wear 用原形。

quiz.question: Dad taught me how ___ an egg.
quiz.hint: how to cook 作 taught 的受詞內容，表示如何煮。

quiz.question: Ben is thinking about who ___ to dinner.
quiz.hint: who to invite 表示該邀請誰，who 是 invite 的受詞。

quiz.question: We have not decided where ___ tonight.
quiz.hint: where to eat 表示該在哪裡吃飯，不定詞用 to eat。

quiz.question: The teacher explained how ___ the new word.
quiz.hint: how to spell 表示如何拼字，to 後接原形動詞。

quiz.question: I know what to ___ when my friend feels sad.
quiz.hint: what to 後的動詞須用原形，因此選 say。

quiz.question: Please tell us where to ___ for the bus.
quiz.hint: where to 後接原形 wait，表示該在哪裡等。

quiz.question: Lisa cannot decide which dress to ___.
quiz.hint: which dress to 後用原形 choose，表示該選哪件洋裝。

quiz.question: My brother showed me how to ___ a kite.
quiz.hint: how to 後接原形 make，表示如何製作。

quiz.question: We need to know when to ___ the meeting.
quiz.hint: when to 後接原形 start，表示何時該開始。

quiz.question: I wonder who to ___ about this problem.
quiz.hint: who to 後接原形 ask，表示該問誰。

quiz.question: Tell me what to ___ on this card.
quiz.hint: what to 後接原形 write，表示該寫什麼。

quiz.question: Do you know how to ___ to the station?
quiz.hint: how to 後接原形 get，表示如何到車站。

quiz.question: The children are learning how to ___ safely.
quiz.hint: how to 後接原形 swim，表示如何游泳。

quiz.question: I have no idea where to ___ my bag.
quiz.hint: where to 後直接用原形 put，不再加另一個 to。

quiz.question: Some students like basketball. ___ like soccer.
quiz.hint: 後面沒有名詞，而且 like 為複數動詞；Others 代替其他一些學生。

quiz.question: Some people walk to school. ___ people take the bus.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 people，須用 Other 修飾。

quiz.question: Some children draw. Others sing. Still ___ dance.
quiz.hint: Still others 後直接接動詞，表示還有一些人。

quiz.question: Some books are new. ___ books are old.
quiz.hint: books 是複數名詞，其前用 Other，不能用代名詞 Others。

quiz.question: Some of my friends play tennis. ___ play baseball.
quiz.hint: 空格後直接接複數動詞 play，用 Others 代替其他一些朋友。

quiz.question: Some students read. Other students write. Still ___ students talk.
quiz.hint: Still other + 複數名詞表示還有一些；students 前用 other。

quiz.question: There are exactly three cups. One is red, another is blue, and ___ is white.
quiz.hint: 已明確限定三個，提過兩個後最後一個用 the other。

quiz.question: Some birds eat seeds. ___ eat fish.
quiz.hint: eat 是複數動詞，且空格後無名詞，使用 Others。

quiz.question: Some girls like music. ___ girls like sports.
quiz.hint: girls 前用形容詞性質的 Other，組成 Other girls。

quiz.question: Some visitors take pictures. Others buy gifts. Still ___ rest.
quiz.hint: Still others 可單獨代替還有一些遊客，後接複數動詞 rest。

quiz.question: I have exactly three pens. One is black, another is red, and ___ is blue.
quiz.hint: 三支筆已提到兩支，剩下唯一一支用 the other。

quiz.question: Some shops sell food. ___ shops sell clothes.
quiz.hint: 空格修飾複數名詞 shops，應用 Other。

quiz.question: Some dogs run fast. ___ run slowly.
quiz.hint: Others 代替其他一些狗，後面直接接複數動詞 run。

quiz.question: Some students bring rice. Others bring bread. Still ___ students bring fruit.
quiz.hint: students 前須用 other；Still other students 表示還有一些學生。

quiz.question: There are exactly three rooms. One is small, another is large, and ___ is empty.
quiz.hint: 三間房中的最後一間已是特定對象，使用 the other。

quiz.question: Some teachers drive to work. ___ take the train.
quiz.hint: take 是複數動詞，空格後沒有名詞，使用 Others。

quiz.question: Some students sit near the door. ___ students sit near the window.
quiz.hint: Other 後可以接複數名詞 students；Others 不再接名詞。

quiz.question: Some people drink tea. Others drink milk. Still ___ drink water.
quiz.hint: Still others 單獨代表還有一些人，接複數動詞 drink。

quiz.question: I bought exactly three hats. One is for Mom, another is for Dad, and ___ is for me.
quiz.hint: 三頂帽子中的前兩頂已分配，最後一頂用 the other。

quiz.question: Some families keep dogs. ___ families keep cats.
quiz.hint: 複數名詞 families 前用 Other 修飾，表示其他一些家庭。

quiz.question: Some students enjoy singing. ___ enjoy dancing.
quiz.hint: Others 可代替其他一些學生，且與複數動詞 enjoy 搭配。

quiz.question: Some children ride bikes. Others play ball. Still ___ children fly kites.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 children，因此使用 Still other children。

quiz.question: There are exactly three chairs. One is broken, another is wet, and ___ is clean.
quiz.hint: 限定三張椅子，已描述兩張，最後一張用 the other。

quiz.question: Some students study at home. ___ study at the library.
quiz.hint: Others 代替其他一些學生，後接複數動詞 study。

quiz.question: Some people like summer. ___ people like winter.
quiz.hint: people 是複數名詞，前面用 Other，形成 Other people。

grammar.sentence: Tom is thinking about where to go.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Tom 正在想該去哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Some students read books, and others draw pictures.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生讀書，其他一些學生畫圖。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me what to do next.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我接下來該做什麼。

grammar.sentence: Other students like to play soccer after school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 其他一些學生喜歡放學後踢足球。

grammar.sentence: Fiona has no idea who to ask for help.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Fiona 不知道該向誰求助。

grammar.sentence: One is red, another is blue, and the other is white.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個是紅色，另一個是藍色，最後一個是白色。

grammar.sentence: Can you show me how to use this phone?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你可以教我如何使用這支手機嗎？

grammar.sentence: Some people walk, and others take the bus.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人走路，其他一些人搭公車。

grammar.sentence: We need to decide when to leave.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們需要決定何時出發。

grammar.sentence: Some sing, others dance, and still others draw.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人唱歌，其他一些人跳舞，還有一些人畫圖。

grammar.sentence: Amy does not know where to park her bike.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Amy 不知道該把腳踏車停在哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Other children play with their dogs in the park.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 其他一些孩子在公園裡和自己的狗玩。

grammar.sentence: The host knows what to say to make us laugh.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 主持人知道該說什麼讓我們發笑。

grammar.sentence: Some birds eat seeds, and others eat fish.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些鳥吃種子，其他一些鳥吃魚。

grammar.sentence: I cannot decide which book to buy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我無法決定該買哪本書。

grammar.sentence: One is small, another is large, and the other is empty.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個很小，另一個很大，最後一個是空的。

grammar.sentence: Dad taught me how to cook an egg.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸教我如何煮蛋。

grammar.sentence: Some students bring rice, and other students bring bread.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生帶飯，其他一些學生帶麵包。

grammar.sentence: Ben is thinking about who to invite.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Ben 正在想該邀請誰。

grammar.sentence: Still others like to play table tennis.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 還有一些人喜歡打桌球。

grammar.sentence: We have not decided where to eat tonight.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們還沒決定今晚要在哪裡吃飯。

grammar.sentence: Some teachers drive, and others take the train.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些老師開車，其他一些老師搭火車。

grammar.sentence: Lisa is not sure what to wear.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Lisa 不確定該穿什麼。

grammar.sentence: One is black, another is red, and the other is blue.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個是黑色，另一個是紅色，最後一個是藍色。

grammar.sentence: Please explain how to open this box.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請解釋如何打開這個盒子。

grammar.sentence: Other families keep cats in their homes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 其他一些家庭在家裡養貓。

grammar.sentence: I wonder who to ask about this problem.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道這個問題該問誰。

grammar.sentence: Some like summer, and others like winter.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人喜歡夏天，其他一些人喜歡冬天。

grammar.sentence: Tell me what to write on this card.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我該在這張卡片上寫什麼。

grammar.sentence: Still other students study at the library.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 還有一些學生在圖書館讀書。
